"Here are research options from several root questions, one per line as key: title. summary, where a key looks like R2:physical:W4. Group options that ask the same question of the same kind of system; every key goes in exactly one cluster, and a key that matches nothing is its own cluster. Name each cluster's topic in at least three words. Decide only from the text below; do not use tools.
R1:physical:K1: Direct multiple shooting. The root question's scheme verbatim: guess the trajectory at every grid point, integrate each sub-interval from its guessed value in parallel, then force continuity with a Newton iteration (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Direct_multiple_shooting_method).
R1:physical:K2: Parareal. The cheap-Jacobian realisation of multiple shooting, introduced by Lions, Maday and Turinici: a coarse serial propagator predicts the trajectory and fine integrators correct each interval in parallel, iterating to convergence (https://parallel-in-time.org/methods/parareal.html).
R1:physical:K3: MGRIT (XBraid). The non-intrusive multigrid-reduction-in-time version of Parareal (shipped as XBraid), which coarsens the time grid rather than using a separate coarse model (https://computing.llnl.gov/projects/parallel-time-integration-multigrid).
R1:physical:K4: ParaDiag / ParaExp (linear diagonalisation). Direct time-parallel methods for linear dynamics: x_T = A^T x_0 is computed by diagonalisation or repeated squaring in O(log T) depth, giving exact parallel-in-time with no forgetting assumption (https://www.unige.ch/~gander/siamtoc3.php).
R1:physical:K5: Parallel cyclic reduction. Parallel cyclic reduction solves the block-bidiagonal Newton correction (a tridiagonal/bidiagonal system) in O(log N) steps with N-fold parallelism, dropping the per-iteration depth of PinT methods from O(T) to O(log T) (https://courses.grainger.illinois.edu/cs554/fa2015/notes/09_tridiagonal_8up.pdf).
R1:physical:K6: Speculative prefetching (MCMC). The MCMC analog of guess+correct: speculatively evaluate many possible accept/reject branches in parallel, keep the true path, discard the rest, with a speedup that is bounded and constant-factor (https://lips.cs.princeton.edu/pdfs/angelino2014accelerating.pdf).
R1:physical:K7: Regeneration / splitting (MCMC). Splitting an MCMC sampler at regeneration times yields i.i.d. tours that can be simulated in parallel, avoiding the bias of many short independent chains (https://galton.uchicago.edu/~mykland/paperlinks/MyklandTierneyYu2291148.pdf).
R1:physical:K8: Coupling from the past (CFTP). Propp-Wilson exact sampling: run the chain from all possible states simultaneously under a monotone coupling, and coalescence certifies an exact draw, efficient only when coalescence (mixing) is fast (https://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~aldous/206-RWG/RWGpapers/propp_wilson.pdf).
R1:physical:K9: Many-chain / data-parallel sampling (TFP HMC). GPUs/TPUs add width two ways — many chains at once and data-parallel gradient/log-density evaluation within one chain — but width does not shorten a single chain's critical path (https://statmodeling.stat.columbia.edu/2022/11/13/stan-and-tensorflow-for-fast-parallel-bayesian-inference/).
R1:physical:K10: GLUE / rainfall-runoff parameter calibration. The actual compute burden in daily-step rainfall-runoff modelling is Monte-Carlo parameter calibration and GLUE uncertainty analysis, parallelised with MPI/OpenMP/CUDA across parameter sets, explicitly not across time steps (https://doi.org/10.3390/w15152810).
R1:physical:K11: Chaotic / non-forgetting PinT. On chaotic systems (Lorenz, hyperbolic PDEs) the coarse-guess error is amplified forward, so Parareal diverges or its superlinear convergence stops, because chaotic initial value problems are inherently ill-conditioned (https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/1880928; https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.10441).
R1:interp:K1: Feature-level causal tracing turns the framer's forgetting condition into a measurement on the real system. Perturb one SAE feature (or hidden state) at layer/token t and trace its indirect effect at t+s; the decay of that effect with lag is the empirical forgetting rate (Lyapunov exponent / mixing) the framer says decides whether guess-then-correct converges. It is the harry lens's 'start two runs a hair apart' done at feature resolution, and it does not itself restructure the computation.
R1:interp:K2: SAE features give the linear basis that triggers the framer's no-forgetting parallel-in-time exception. If the residual-stream trajectory is a linear combination of sparse features, the per-step feature transition is (approximately) linear and x_T = A^T x_0 is computable in O(log T) depth by repeated squaring / diagonalisation (the framer's ParaDiag exception), with no forgetting needed. Goodfire-style SAEs supply the linear decomposition; the open question is whether the feature-to-feature transition is stable enough to compose out of order.
R1:interp:K3: Feature steering is a learned correction operator that replaces the Newton step. Instead of a Newton correction J^{-1}F, correct a guessed trajectory by clamping an SAE feature at an intermediate layer (add a constant in the direction of that feature) and continue the forward pass; a single feature edit (Golden Gate Claude) reliably propagates through the remainder of generation, and the [-5,5] steering sweet spot is the empirical analog of the framer's forgetting/contraction condition, outside which the correction destabilises downstream.
R1:interp:K4: Autoregressive decoding is the LLM instantiation of the framer's problem, and guess-then-correct already works there, gated by the forgetting interp measures. Decoding K tokens is K serial forward passes, and the guess-whole-trajectory-then-correct solution is speculative decoding (draft several tokens ahead, verify in one parallel pass; 2-3x on T5-XXL, identical outputs) and Jacobi parallel decoding (initialise the whole sequence, refine all tokens in parallel to a fixed point; up to 38% speedup, ~2x on parallel resources). Both pay off exactly when the model forgets fast, i.e. the draft/target acceptance rate E[min(p,q)] is high, which is the quantity interp tools (tuned lens, causal tracing) measure.
